reviews.reviewbody: I like these types of tapes better. Longer tapes, short conversations.. Different topics. Here we get a mishmash of different topics, what LBJ does at Camp David, potential spies, potential candidates, and potential bills. Some of it is less interesting then the others, but I guess that's what happens when you've got the President on the phone..
reviews.reviewtitle: 2 bowls of soup and a game of bowling.
